info.title: Shellui Hosting API
info.description: App hosting API for Shellui. Authenticate with a Bearer JWT issued by identity-service. Use **Authorize** and enter `Bearer <token>` or paste the raw JWT; when opened from Shellui Admin, the session token is applied automatically.

get.description:
Returns delivery status, attempt counts, and errors for the company.

Permissions: Shellui company owner for the target company, or Shellui staff. Send `Authorization: Bearer <jwt>` from identity-service. Deploy tokens (`hdt_`) may call preview deploy, upload, and finalize routes for preview sites only. Shellui MCP agent tokens cannot create deploy tokens.

Side effects: Read-only.

Sends email: No.

Destructive: No.

Staff may filter by `scheduled_job_run_id` (not exposed on MCP).

parameters.name: company_id
parameters.description: Target company. Owners omit this when their JWT already carries `company_id`. Staff may set it to administer another company on Shellui Actions routes.

parameters.name: scheduled_job_run_id
parameters.description: Staff only. Deliveries that have an attempt from this scheduled job run.

status.description:
Hosting access state. Deploy APIs require `approved`.

* `pending` - pending
* `approved` - approved
* `denied` - denied

secret.description: Plaintext signing secret. Returned once on create or rotate only.

slug.description: Public site slug used in URLs.

expires_at.description: Preview expiry (ISO 8601). Null for production sites. Previews last 7 days after each finalize.

name.description: Unique slug under the company (lowercase, hyphens).

upload_url.description: HTTPS URL for a raw PUT of the `.tar.gz` artifact. Treat as a secret when using S3 presigned URLs.

headers.description: Headers to send with the upload (for example `Content-Type: application/gzip`).

requires_bearer.description: When true, repeat the same `Authorization: Bearer` agent token on the PUT request.

expires_at.description: UTC expiry for the upload URL.

backend.description:
`s3` uses a presigned object URL. `direct` PUTs to hosting-service with your agent token.

* `s3` - s3
* `direct` - direct

verified.description: True only after the platform confirms DNS. Always false until edge integration ships.

serving.description: True only when the edge serves TLS for this hostname. Always false in this release.

hostname.description: Fully qualified hostname (not under the default app hosting domain).

verification_txt_name.description: TXT record name relative to the hostname (underscore label).

verification_txt_value.description: TXT value to publish for DNS verification.

token.description: Plaintext deploy token. Returned once on create; stored hashed server-side.

app_version.description: Semver of your app build (for example `1.2.3`).

shellui_version.description: Shellui framework version bundled in the artifact.

pinned.description: When true, rollback skips this deployment unless explicitly selected.

value_present.description: Whether a value is stored. Values are never returned.

value.description: New value. Never echoed in list or get responses.
New value. Never echoed in list or get responses.

statusCode.description: HTTP status as a string (for example `400`, `404`).

message.description: Human-readable detail. Prefer `error` for programmatic handling.

field_errors.description: Optional map of field names to stable validation tokens (for example `required`, `invalid`).

request_id.description: Echo of the `X-Request-ID` header when present.

slug.description: Optional preview slug. Omit to allocate a new slug.

shellui_version.description: Shellui framework version in the bundle.

path.description: Request path and query only; query values are not redacted.

bearerAuth.description: JWT access token issued by identity-service. Paste `Bearer <token>` or the raw JWT.

deployTokenAuth.description: Company deploy token (`hdt_` prefix) for CI preview uploads. Scoped to preview sites for the token company.
